MSliderModel::orientation [read, write]

Slider orientation. Can be Qt::Horizontal or Qt::Vertical.

MSliderModel::state [read, write]

Slider state (it can be either MSliderModel::Released or MSliderModel::Pressed).

MSliderModel::steps [read, write]

Slider value range subinterval (steps). If 0 there are no steps. If there are steps slider values are limited to integer multiples of step values.

MSliderModel::value [read, write]

Slider value (value in slider range). Values are bounded into slider range.
